originalGenerationMetadata.actualAuthorFinding: Flowering versus seed-head stages and wilting-coloured leaves visually stand in for genetic variation/evolution; separate variation at the same life stage and evolution from ontogeny.
originalGenerationMetadata.exactPrompt: Edit this actual SkillPilot biodiversity illustration with only two scientific corrections; preserve the friendly comic landscape16:9, five separated panels, overall soft colours, large legible labels, good Arten/Ökosysteme/Schutz panels and protection hands. In top-left Variation panel, show three healthy plants of the same illustrative plant species at the same mature flowering life stage: all have one open yellow flower and the same overall basic form, while their healthy green leaves differ slightly in width and lobing. No seed-head, wilted brown leaves or different plant ages as the variation contrast. In bottom-left panel, replace the plant-growth/flower-to-seed picture with a small abstract branching evolutionary tree: one ancestral plant symbol on the left branches through time into three distinct, healthy flowering plant lineages on the right, all illustrated at the same mature life stage; use a simple leaf-shape/flower-shape difference, not stages of a single plant. Three non-overlapping brown forward arrows clearly diverge; no progress ladder, no preferred higher organism, no deliberate improvement. Replace only this panel's German label "Entwicklung" with the clearer large exact label "Evolution". Keep the large exact labels Variation, Arten, Ökosysteme, Schutz elsewhere. No phylogenetic species names, no dates/numeric evidence, no extra paragraphs. Raster PNG near1600x900; remain readable at360px.

altDe: Gesunde Pflanzen derselben Blühphase zeigen Variation; weitere Felder zeigen Arten und Ökosysteme. Ein abstrahiertes Verzweigungsschema zu Evolution und schützende Hände ergänzen die drei Ebenen.
altEn: Healthy plants at the same flowering stage show variation; further panels show species and ecosystems. An abstract branching evolution diagram and protective hands accompany the three levels.
